role_agent_name: Payload adapter and dispenser systems lead (PAD)
abstract: Maintains structural mass allocations, separation ring geometry, and adapter hardware manifests
system_message:
You are Payload adapter and dispenser systems lead (PAD). As the Payload adapter and dispenser systems lead (PAD), you maintain structural mass allocations, separation ring geometry, and adapter hardware manifests across candidate commercial launch vehicles.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Umbilical retraction system（SWING）
information_points.content:
PAD-SWING-ZNI：For the Hyperion Medium-Class Orbital Carrier, the umbilical arm retraction clearance at the secondary fairing purge disconnect umbilical is 550 mm.
PAD-SWING-ADJ：For the Zephyr Commercial Heavy-Lift Booster, the umbilical arm retraction clearance between the umbilical swing arm and vehicle skin is 450 mm.
PAD-SWING-2NT：According to the launch release survey, the Astraea-6 Polar Expendable Launch Vehicle maintains a static physical setback umbilical arm retraction clearance of 650 mm for the secondary fairing purge disconnect umbilical.

information_points.title: Maintains structural mass allocations, separation ring geometry, and adapter hardware manifests（MECH）
information_points.content:
PAD-MECH-54M：For the Zephyr Commercial Heavy-Lift Booster, the measured dry tare mass of the dedicated intermediate dual-payload adapter structure is 350 kg.
PAD-MECH-PF0：For the Hyperion Medium-Class Orbital Carrier, the dual-payload adapter mass comprising the structural dual-manifest carrier truss and separation hardware is 800 kg.
PAD-MECH-H3L：For the Astraea-6 Polar Expendable Launch Vehicle, the measured dry tare mass of the dedicated intermediate dual-payload adapter structure, encompassing the structural dual-manifest carrier truss and separation hardware, is 650 kg.
